pcb_stack_world_z_mm.note: Board is 0.8mm finished, lowered from Z21.8 to Z21.0 for the 8mm Pi socket stack (connector-stack-review.json).

screen_change.summary: Screen plane lowered 0.8mm in world Z (fascia_screen_center_z 8.0109 -> 7.2109; screen active centre world Z 35.3109 -> 34.5109). Pod base, seam and slope unchanged; pod front lip now 0.575mm above its base (0.875mm above the deck with the 0.3mm seam).
follow_on_changes: Front screen-pod screws moved from Y4.2 to Y9.2 so their blind holes keep skin under the lowered face
Rear-left PCB edge guide narrowed 8 -> 7mm and centred at Y25.5 (spans Y22..29, still ends at the board rear edge) to clear the lowered retainer by 0.39mm
Rear silicone pad: 5.8 x 1.6mm die-cut notch over the two frontmost GPIO tails (0.67mm clearance, 0.8mm connecting strip kept)

active_connector.contacts: top contact (supplier: 上接); exposed copper of the back-folded tail faces up
active_connector.opening: horizontal -Y, toward the screen tail exit
active_connector.socket_terminal_to_panel_terminal: socket=11-panel; pad10 SCLK at world +X2.25, pad1 VSSA/GND at -X2.25
active_connector.pin_order_evidence: Sharp LS027B7DH01 PDF26: display-side-up view marks terminal1 on the right; the 180-degree back fold about X keeps X

slot_world_mm.basis: Mouth from the JLCEDA/EasyEDA STEP (SHA504b9584...): the housing solid has a 0.4mm-high entry pocket from housing front Y3.07 to Y3.97 at seat+1.05..1.45. The STEP housing is otherwise a filled block (volume 55.6mm3 confirms no modelled interior slot, stop or contacts), so the stop is NOT measurable from the model. 2.7mm insertion is read from supplier drawing section A-A and is an interpretation, not a certified mating dimension.
slot_world_mm.correction: Earlier same-day records quoted a 'stop at ref Y0.15 / 2.73mm from STEP sections'; that came from point sampling of the multi-solid compound, which gave false cavities. Corrected here.

open_stroke_mm.qualification: Supplier drawing open depth 6.7 minus closed 5.2; whole-body extension toward -Y, not a kinematic simulation

native_tail.exit_basis: Screen frame origin (0,21.5212,34.5109), rotation X13deg; glass edge local Y-23.18; tail plane local Z-2.23 (front surface -1.4 minus front polariser 0.23 and front glass 0.6)

width_mm.near_glass: 8.64-9.5 for the first ~6.2-6.9mm (drawing views disagree), tapering to 5.5

free_length_estimate.datum: Along the tail from the glass exit edge to the physical tip, including the stiffener.
free_length_estimate.basis: Drawing-proportion estimate: front view scales to ~13.4mm, back view to ~14.1mm. Only dimensioned related value is 47.28+/-0.5 from panel top to the tail notch line (4.46mm below the glass edge).
free_length_estimate.qualification: User delegated estimation. Do not claim fit validation or stretch the cable.

route_review.summary: Drop from the tail exit to the cable centre at the mouth is 4.079mm. With the 2.7mm insertion from the supplier drawing, 13.2/13.7/14.2mm tails end their last bend at 5.583/5.745/5.906mm from the glass edge (limit 6.0). Shortest tail that reaches the assumed stop: 12.25mm.
route_review.route_family: straight a=0.8 at 193deg; arc R1 to 270deg; vertical straight; arc R2=0.615 (centreline, inner R0.45 at 0.33mm worst thickness) to 0deg; horizontal straight at Z23.045 into the mouth
route_review.sensitivity_insertion_1.93mm: If the tail only enters 1.93mm past the housing front, 13.2/13.7/14.2mm end at 5.832/5.993/6.155mm: 14.2mm would exceed the zone. The real insertion depth is the main prototype check.

clearances_mm.method: Swept band 9.5mm wide to s=8.9 then 5.5mm, 0.3mm thick, exact distance to committed CAD objects, worst over the three lengths
clearances_mm.pcb_before_mouth: rides on the drawer top at the mouth (0.03); 1.05 above the board top

route_review.previous_state: Before the screen drop (board at Z21.0, screen centre Z35.31) the shortest legal route ended at 6.18mm: fail.
route_review.method: Analytic route plus exact boolean/distance checks (cad.inspect eval).

negative_channel.scope: Local negative clearance in fascia and retainer, centred 2.17mm below the tail exit (follows the screen). Narrower than the 8.64-9.5mm tail near the glass; the older 11mm-wide fold cut in the screen parts provides the width there.

retired_route.summary: An earlier layout assumed an inverted bottom-contact Hirose FH12 socket hanging under the screen pod, with a 180-degree fold of inner R1.35mm and an 11mm-wide negative path cut into the fascia and retainer. That socket is no longer in the design; the board uses C5373447. Only the 11mm channel cut remains, moving with the screen.

signal_review.pin_map: Released board pads: 1 GND(VSSA), 2 GND(VSS), 3-5 V5_LCD(EXTMODE,VDD,VDDA), 6 LCD_DISP, 7 LCD_COM, 8 LCD_SCS, 9 LCD_SI, 10 LCD_SCLK; socket = 11 - panel terminal
signal_review.pi_header: SCLK<-GPIO11 pin23, SI<-GPIO10 pin19 (MOSI), SCS<-GPIO8 pin24 (CE0), EXTCOMIN<-GPIO12 pin32 (PWM0), DISP<-GPIO25 pin22, LCD power enable GPIO24 pin18; matches product/references/pi-gpio-pinout.png
signal_review.levels: Signals buffered by SN74AHC125 at 3.3V: VOH ~3.3V meets Sharp VIH 2.7V min / 3.0V recommended (PDF13); VDD/VDDA 5V from current-limited switch (Sharp 4.8-5.5V); EXTMODE high selects EXTCOMIN mode
signal_review.release_gates: Release 69ac2649 published with fabrication, assembly and mechanical sections ready

service.assembly: Power off. Release the screen pod and reach the connector from the rear; support the glass independently. Pull the drawer evenly at both ends, insert the straight stiffener copper-up fully, push the drawer closed before fastening the pod. Remove the Pi if needed for access.
service.operation_qualification: Envelope clears nominal structure; finger access, pull force and full drawer travel are not qualified.
